Tidy the output of a dust2 simulation

Source: R/simulation.R
tidy_simulation.Rd

Convert the array returned by dust2::dust_system_simulate() (or the state returned by dust2::dust_system_state()) into a long-format tibble with one row per variable, time, particle and group.

Usage

tidy_simulation(
  y,
  sys,
  times,
  index_state = NULL,
  vars = NULL,
  dims = NULL,
  labels = NULL
)

Arguments

y

An array returned by dust2::dust_system_simulate(), or by dust2::dust_system_state() if times is NULL.

sys

The dust_system that produced y.

times

The times passed to dust2::dust_system_simulate(). Use NULL if y is a state with no time dimension.

index_state

The index_state used to produce y, if any.

vars

Optional character vector of variables to keep, for example c("I", "incidence"). Selecting variables before reshaping is much cheaper than filtering afterwards.

dims

Optional names for the dimensions of array variables. Either an unnamed character vector applied by position to every array variable (c("age", "vax")), or a named list giving the dimension names of each variable (list(S = c("age", "vax"), R = "age")). Dimensions that are not named produce columns index1, index2, and so on.

labels

Optional named list of labels for dimensions, for example list(age = c("child", "adult")). Labelled dimensions become factors. Use the name group to label parameter groups.

Value

A tibble with columns group and particle (where the system has them), time, variable (a factor, with levels in the order the model stores its state), one column per array dimension (NA for variables without that dimension) and value.

Details

The array on its own does not say whether its middle dimensions are particles or parameter groups, nor what its times were, so the system that produced it and the times are needed too.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # requireNamespace("odin2", quietly = TRUE) && interactive()
sir <- odin2::odin({
  deriv(S) <- -beta * S * I / N
  deriv(I) <- beta * S * I / N - gamma * I
  initial(S) <- N - 1
  initial(I) <- 1
  N <- parameter(1000)
  beta <- parameter(0.4)
  gamma <- parameter(0.1)
})
sys <- dust2::dust_system_create(sir, list())
dust2::dust_system_set_state_initial(sys)
t <- seq(0, 100)
y <- dust2::dust_system_simulate(sys, t)
tidy_simulation(y, sys, t)
}
